en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural Scandinavian scene labeled "Ökna." In the foreground is a dirt road lined with traditional wooden fencing and haystacks in a field. To the right stands a dark wooden farmhouse or manor with white‑framed windows and a tall ladder leaning up to the attic gable. In the middle distance, a group of people and a horse‑drawn carriage gather near a gate shaded by large trees. Behind the trees rises a round church tower with arched openings, balcony railing, and a cross on top, suggesting a village church.
